title: Business Office Standard — Final Statement, Credit Balance Refund and Closing the Independent Living File
content:
## Standard

**Final statement.** After the apartment is vacated, a final statement for the Independent Living Residency Agreement is issued no later than the final statement period of the apartment type, in calendar days after the vacate date, showing every charge through the fee end date, the carpet cleaning fee and every credit.

**Refund of a credit balance.** A credit balance shown on the final statement is refunded by check or ACH in one refund payable to the resident, or to the resident's estate when a date of death is on the customer profile.

**Only after vacating.** A credit balance refund may be issued only while the residency is in vacated status; a credit balance on a continuing residency is carried forward to the next billing month instead.

**Closing the file.** The residency file may be closed only when the account balance and the reservation deposit held are both 0.00.

**Unpaid balances.** An unpaid balance on a vacated residency stays open for collection and is never written off by the desk.

## Decision table

| Residency status | Account balance | Reservation deposit held | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Vacated | Credit (negative) | — | Credit balance refunded by check or ACH in one refund, to the resident or the estate |
| Active or notice given | Credit | — | Carried forward to the next billing month; no refund |
| Vacated | 0.00 | 0.00 | File may be closed |
| Vacated | Owed (positive) | Any | Stays open for collection; never written off by the desk |
| Vacated | 0.00 | Above 0.00 | File may not be closed |

## Payee of a refund

| Date of death on the customer profile | Refund payable to |
|---|---|
| Not recorded | The resident |
| Recorded | The resident's estate |

Hypothetical example: an apartment vacated on June 12 under a 30-day final statement period has its final statement issued no later than July 12.
